本仪表盘由 GitHub Actions 定时工作流自动生成。它定期抓取 Hyp: Iyi mbonerahamwe ikorwa mu buryo bwikora n'urukurikirane rw'akazi gahunda rwa GitHub Actions. Ikura API rusange ya Hypixel SkyBlock buri gihe kandi igereranya buri gisubizo n'ifoto ibanza; imirima yongewe, yasibwe cyangwa yahinduwe yandikwa mu buryo bwo gusubira kureba kode mu gitabo cy'impinduka hejuru. “Verisiyo iriho” yo hejuru y'urupapuro ituruka mu murima version w'endpoint ebyiri z'ibikoresho, collections na skills: kubera ko Hypixel isohora ivugurura mu matsinda, izo endpoint ebyiri ntizihinduka buri gihe icyarimwe, bityo verisiyo nshya yemezwa gusa iyo verisiyo zombi zihuye; iyo zitahuye, verisiyo iheruka itajegajega igumaho kandi hakagaragazwa “verisiyo irimo guhuza”, kugira ngo umubare wa verisiyo utajya usimbuka hano n'ahandi. Guhinduka kwa verisiyo kwandikwa ukwaho mu paneli “urutonde rwa verisiyo” kandi ntibivangwa n'igitabo cy'impinduka z'ibiri muri endpoint; iyo paneli nayo ibika gusa iminsi 30 ishize n'inyandiko zitarenze 20. Imihindagurikire y'ibiciro bya bazaar yashunguwe — hakurikiranwa gusa ibyongewe n'ibyasibwe mu buryo bw'imyubakire y'ibicuruzwa. Endpoint y'amapaki (packs) ihora ifata verisiyo ifite agaciro ka packFormat karusha ubundi (uwo mubare uhinduka uko MC ivugururwa), iyo hash yemewe ihindutse ikura zip ikayifungura, hanyuma igereranya ibyongewe, ibyasibwe n'impinduka z'inyandiko ziri mu paki hakoreshejwe hash y'ibiri mu nyandiko; inyandiko z'inyandiko zahinduwe zerekana gusa igice cyahindutse mu mutuku no mu cyatsi, naho inyandiko nshya zigaragazwa mu cyatsi gusa. Endpoint ya Bingo (bingo) yandika igihe cyo gutangaza n'igihe cyo gutangira no kurangira kwa buri gihe, kandi itondeka imirimo yose mu rutonde rwa 5×5 (ibumoso ugana iburyo, hejuru ugana hasi; kanda akazu urebe inyandiko yose); ibara ry'igihe ritanga mushakisha milisagonda za epoch za start / end kugira ngo zibarirwe buri segonda, nta ngaruka y'ikindi gihe cyo gukurura cya Actions; kode z'amabara za Minecraft (§) mu nyandiko y'imirimo zigaragazwa n'amabara yemewe, kandi aho bigeze kuri server yose ni ugagaragaza gusa ntibigira uruhare mu kugereranya impinduka. Endpoint y'ibicuruzwa by'agateganyo (firesales) ikurwa bushya buri gihe gikorwa (mbere y'uko ubucuruzi butangira abayobozi bashobora guhindura igihe, umubare cyangwa igiciro); buri gihe kiba ikarita yihariye igaragaza igiciro n'umubare, kandi buto “erekana amakuru y'inyongera” ifungura ibihe byose hamwe na JSON mbisi. Niba endpoint iyo ari yo yose cyangwa gukurura paki byanze, iki gikorwa nta makuru ayo ari yo yose gihindura mu bubiko.
